solution:
Identify what we know:
• Area = 18cm²
• Both sides must be natural numbers
• We need to find: The SMALLEST perimeter

Find the min perimeter: Looking at our table, the smallest perimeter is 18 cm when the sides are 6 cm × 3 cm. Key: For a fixed area, a rectangle has the smallest perimeter when the sides are as close as possible!
